_comment: This index declares which jurisdictions the Navigator serves and which rule files compose each one. The server merges each jurisdiction's 'compose' files in order (federal base -> shared content -> state overlay); later files override earlier ones. 'defaultJurisdiction' is only a fallback - the app asks each person to choose their own state, so there is never a wrong default applied to results. To add a Gulf South state (e.g., Mississippi, Alabama, Florida), add a verified overlay file and a new entry here. NEVER claim coverage for a state that does not have a verified overlay file. NEVER put eligibility logic in this file - it is data only.
